sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "scores" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "composer" TEXT NULL, "source" TEXT NULL, "source_link" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "search_text" TEXT NOT NULL, "recent_time" TEXT NOT NULL GENERATED ALWAYS AS (MAX(last_opened, metadata_updated_at, file_updated_at)) VIRTUAL, "last_opened" TEXT NOT NULL, "metadata_updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "file_updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "written_at" TEXT NULL, "metadata_uploaded" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("metadata_uploaded" IN (0, 1)), "file_uploaded" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("file_uploaded" IN (0, 1)), "file_downloaded" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("file_downloaded" IN (0, 1)), "file_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "annotations" TEXT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'score', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "genres" ("score" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES scores (id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE CASCADE, "genre" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("score", "genre"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "instruments" ("score" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES scores (id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE CASCADE, "instrument" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("score", "instrument"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tags" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "color" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'score', "written_at" TEXT NULL, "uploaded" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("uploaded" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "score_tags" ("score" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES scores (id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE CASCADE, "tag" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tags (id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE CASCADE, PRIMARY KEY ("score", "tag"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "key_value" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "deleted_tags" ("tag_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("tag_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "deleted_scores" ("score_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("score_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "log_message" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "session_start_time" TEXT NOT NULL, "time" TEXT NOT NULL, "level" TEXT NOT NULL, "tag" TEXT NOT NULL, "message" TEXT NOT NULL, "stack_trace" TEXT NOT NULL, "exception" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "setlists" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "written_at" TEXT NULL, "uploaded" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("uploaded" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "setlist_entries" ("setlist" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES setlists (id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE CASCADE, "score" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("setlist", "position"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "deleted_setlists" ("setlist_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("setlist_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exercise_categories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "written_at" TEXT NULL, "uploaded" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("uploaded" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exercises" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NULL REFERENCES exercise_categories (id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE RESTRICT, "description" TEXT NULL, "source" TEXT NULL, "source_link" TEXT NULL, "instrument" TEXT NULL, "target_bpm" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "written_at" TEXT NULL, "uploaded" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("uploaded" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exercise_scores" ("exercise" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES exercises (id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE CASCADE, "score" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("exercise", "position"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exercise_tags" ("exercise" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES exercises (id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE CASCADE, "tag" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tags (id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE CASCADE, PRIMARY KEY ("exercise", "tag"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "practice_routines" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "written_at" TEXT NULL, "uploaded" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("uploaded" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "practice_routine_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "routine" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES practice_routines (id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE CASCADE, "exercise" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES exercises (id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE RESTRICT, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "extra_notes" TEXT NULL, "target_duration" INTEGER NULL, "default_score" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "practice_sessions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "started_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "ended_at" TEXT NULL, "routine" TEXT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "written_at" TEXT NULL, "uploaded" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("uploaded" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "practice_session_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "session" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES practice_sessions (id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE CASCADE, "exercise" TEXT NOT NULL, "routine_entry" TEXT NULL, "duration" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "running_since" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "deleted_exercise_categories" ("category_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("category_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "deleted_exercises" ("exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("exercise_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "deleted_practice_routines" ("routine_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("routine_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "deleted_practice_sessions" ("session_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("session_id"));
CREATE INDEX search_text_index ON scores (search_text)
CREATE INDEX recent_time_index ON scores (recent_time)
CREATE INDEX exercises_category_index ON exercises (category)
CREATE INDEX exercise_scores_score_index ON exercise_scores (score)
CREATE INDEX practice_routine_entries_routine_index ON practice_routine_entries (routine)
CREATE INDEX practice_routine_entries_exercise_index ON practice_routine_entries (exercise)
CREATE INDEX practice_sessions_started_at_index ON practice_sessions (started_at)
CREATE INDEX practice_sessions_routine_index ON practice_sessions (routine)
CREATE INDEX practice_session_entries_exercise_index ON practice_session_entries (exercise)
CREATE INDEX practice_session_entries_routine_entry_index ON practice_session_entries (routine_entry)
